result.summary: The page is generally well laid out. One visible visual inconsistency appears in the navigation bar, where the selected Profile tab styling does not match the rest of the UI cleanly.

issues.description: The active Profile navigation item uses green for its icon and label, but the icon’s circular user mark is noticeably thinner/smaller in visual weight than the other navigation icons, making the active tab appear less balanced.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the Profile icon size and stroke weight to align with the visual weight and dimensions of the Home, Search, and Orders icons.
